label: Pre-trip AI use for destination research
question: What do travellers use AI for before a trip?
answer: 38% use AI for destination research, 37% for local experiences and 36% for restaurant recommendations.
sample: Pre-trip use among AI users, 33 markets
methodology: Booking.com Global AI Sentiment Report, April–May 2025. Shares are of consumers who use AI in travel, not of all consumers.
